title: SM ST10C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine ST10C static excitation system with automatic voltage regulator, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)}, {Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)}, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Regulator gain, K_R (pu)}, {Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_B1 (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant, {Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_C1 (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant, {Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_B2 (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant, {Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_C2 (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant, {UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_UB1 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lag time constant, {UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_UC1 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lead time constant, {UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_UB2 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lag time constant, {UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_UC2 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lead time constant, {OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_OB1 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lag time constant, {OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_OC1 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lead time constant, {OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_OB2 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lag time constant, {OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_OC2 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lead time constant, {Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)}, {Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)}, {Maximum PSS regulator output, V_RSmax (pu)}, {Minimum PSS regulator output, V_RSmin (pu)}, {Alternate PSS input locations (V_S)} sets the pSS input location Summation point at output, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location Summation point at voltage, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location Summation point at voltage, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location Summation point at voltage, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}, {Equivalent time constant for rectifier bridge, T_1 (s)} sets the time constant for rectifier bridge, {Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} sets the potential circuit voltage gain coefficient, {Potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} sets the potential circuit current gain coefficient, {Reactance associated with the potential source, X_L (pu)} sets the potential source reactance, {Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)}, {Maximum available exciter voltage, V_Bmax (pu)} sets the exciter voltage upper limit and {Power source selector}. Values come from the instance.
